task_instance: Use commit-craft to turn a tangled working tree into a reviewable commit series: on a small sample git repo (feature+test edit in app.py/tests, a dependency bump in package.json, and a stray .env holding a fake AWS secret), run commit_planner.py to group/order commits and hold back the secret file, secret_gate.py to block staged secrets before committing, and message_linter.py to lint commit messages.
blocker_detail: The required bundled script scripts/secret_gate.py (the skill's 'blocks staged secrets' component and mandatory step 2 of its workflow) cannot run. In the delivered skill copy a placeholder (standing for a chat-service webhook address I cannot reach) was substituted into a live regex literal on line 49: re.compile of a pattern beginning with a bracket placeholder makes the regex an invalid character class, so importing the module raises re.PatternError: bad character range l-1 and every invocation (including --sample and --help) crashes before doing anything. The round rules forbid guessing/looking up the original address and the run rules forbid writing my own replacement/stub of a bundled script, so the gate is unusable as delivered. commit_planner.py and message_linter.py have no such corruption and work.
evidence: Set up work dir, copied scripts/ from the skill, created sampleproj git repo with an initial commit, then a tangled working tree: app.py (new multiply fn) + tests/test_app.py (new test), package.json (dep bump), and untracked .env with a fake AWS secret. STEP 1 WORKS: `python3 scripts/commit_planner.py` on the real tree printed 'BLOCKED: 4 files -> 2 commit(s); 1 file(s) held back', grouping [1] package.json as build(deps), [2] app.py + tests/test_app.py (test rides with its source), flagging .env as DO_NOT_COMMIT/BLOCKER and holding it out of every group; exit 4 as documented. STEP 3 WORKS: `message_linter.py -m 'fix'` -> BLOCKED VAGUE_SUBJECT exit 4; `message_linter.py -m 'build(deps): pin left-pad and add zod for schema validation'` -> CLEAN exit 0. STEP 2 FAILS: `python3 scripts/secret_gate.py` (staged and sample) aborts with a traceback at module load (re._compiler ... re.PatternError: bad character range l-1) from the placeholder-corrupted regex at scripts/secret_gate.py line 49. ast.parse of the file succeeds (valid Python string) but re.compile of that pattern at import time raises. grep found the fatal placeholder only in that one live pattern; the other placeholder occurrences are inside SAMPLE_DIFF string data (harmless to syntax). No .env was ever committed; git log shows only the initial 'chore: initial project' commit and the tangled changes remain in the working tree. Because the mandatory secret-gating step cannot run and must not be reconstructed or replaced, the skill's full secure-commit workflow could not be completed end to end.
